results.description:
# Australian Public Service (Federal)
## APS Salary Guide by Classification
### APS 3 Salary
AnAPS 3 (also written as APS3 or APS Level 3) earns **$72,397–$76,820** gross — roughly $59,000–$62,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus15.4% employer super (~$84,000–$89,000 total package).

### APS 5 Salary
AnAPS 5 (also written as APS5 or APS Level 5) earns **$89,463–$97,837** gross — roughly $70,000–$76,000 take-home after income tax and Medicare, plus15.4% employer super (~$103,000–$113,000 total package).

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What is the APS 1 salary?
An APS 1 (also written as APS1 or APS Level 1) earns $57,497 to $60,946 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027.

### What is the APS 2 salary?
An APS 2 (also written as APS2 or APS Level 2) earns $62,775 to $69,317 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027.

### What is the APS 3 salary?
An APS 3 (also written as APS3 or APS Level 3) earns $72,397 to $76,820 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027.

### What is the APS 4 salary?
An APS 4 (also written as APS4 or APS Level 4) earns $79,731 to $86,246 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027.

### What is the APS 5 salary?
An APS 5 (also written as APS5 or APS Level 5) earns $89,463 to $97,837 per year as set by the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027.

### What are the current APS salary scales?
The current Australian Public Service Commission salary scale is set under the Australian Public Service Commission Enterprise Agreement 2024-2027 and spans $57,497–$174,790 across APS 1–6 and Executive Level 1–2.
